source: factory/recipes/lovable-kit/hero-kit-v1 (extracted from Mark's Lovable projects — zero credits spent)
note: Hex values approximate the kit's oklch()/hsl() originals, clamped where needed to the renderer's accent-contrast bands. atmosphere[] lists the vanilla atmosphere-pack ids available to the Premier V8 renderer.

recipes.notes: Full-bleed video + parallax + blueprint schematic SVG grid overlay (counter-parallax) + film grain + kinetic marquee + live yardage estimator. Blueprint overlay ported as the 'blueprint' pack; marquee/grain/estimator already exist in v7.

Mouse-reactive ember spotlight ported as the 'spotlight' pack (radial gradient tracks cursor, 600px circle). Ken Burns, grain, CountUp strip and service-atlas map already have v7 equivalents (kenburns keyframe, .grain, stat-row, service-map-pins family). Topo contour SVG + seasonal paving-window widget skipped: heavy, vertical-specific copy.

Rotating photo z-stack cycler ported as the 'photo-stack' pack — 3 stacked offset plates, timed crossfade (kit used 5 frames @ 5.2s; v7 uses 3 photos @ 4s per the port spec). Gold diagonal rules + signature card skipped (brand-specific ornament).

Full-viewport video loop + trust strip — v7's flagship cinematic-video hero already covers this. Welcome-audio player (voice + 20% music bed, 900ms fades) RETIRED for the static renderer: needs per-client licensed audio assets and click-initiated playback UI; no honest deterministic fallback.

GoldParticles canvas ported verbatim to vanilla as the 'gold-particles' pack: ~40 drifting particles, radial-glow + core dot, sine pulse, wrap at edges, RAF, accent-tinted via data-accent, removed under reduced-motion. Framer Motion staggered reveal covered by v7 .kinetic; radiating rings + frosted card skipped (ornament).

RETIRED for v7: the kit ships only the orchestrator — the 8 child components (~2000 lines: water surface, gyroscope, ripples, floating can) were never extracted and are brand-coupled to Coco Love. Not a service-business pattern; nothing deterministic to port.

AtmosphereLayers ported as the 'atmosphere' pack: 2 counter-drifting SVG-turbulence fog layers + anamorphic light-sweep (~13s cycle) + letterbox bars. Split-tone grade/vignette approximated by v7's existing .tint/.veil; 18 dust sprites folded into fog to stay in the pack's line budget. EstimatorWidget already lives in v7 as data-estimator (kept).

The calm baseline — photo + gradient veil + eyebrow chip + soft rise, deliberately NO atmosphere pack. Maps to atmosphere id 'none' for wellness-adjacent trades (cleaning) where dense motion would feel wrong.
